name: The Snowball - Hardening to Postgreyskull
description: Integrated roadmap from production hardening to vectorized graph memory.

userStories.title: Mandatory Sandbox & Dev Mode
userStories.description: Enforce sandboxing by default and implement --dev-mode flag.
acceptanceCriteria: Fail if sandbox_mode is 'none' in production

userStories.title: Execution Timeouts & Resource Killers
userStories.description: Enforce timeouts and resource limits for tool/provider calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Add exec_timeout and memory_limit to donkey.toml
Implement SIGKILL for sandboxed processes exceeding limits

userStories.title: JSON Logging & Metrics Endpoint
userStories.description: Standardize observability with structured logs and metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Include request_id and latency in all logs

userStories.title: ZenAdapter (Multi-Protocol Gateway)
userStories.description: Unified gateway for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini protocols.
acceptanceCriteria: Map opencode/ models to respective protocols

userStories.title: Advanced Reliability (Retry, Failover, Circuit Breaker)
userStories.description: Implement automatic resilience for provider instability.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Exponential Backoff Retry in HttpPort

userStories.title: Network Boundary (Deny by Default)
userStories.description: Enforce strict network allowlists for tools and providers.
acceptanceCriteria: Block private/metadata IPs at DNS layer

userStories.title: Postgreyskull - Vector Integration
userStories.description: Episodic memory using vector embeddings in PostgreSQL.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement bidirectional sync between DB and .md files
Verify with real PostgreSQL in Docker

userStories.title: Hybrid Semantic Search (Vector + Graph)
userStories.description: Hybrid search combining pgvector and Apache AGE Cypher traversals.
acceptanceCriteria: Integrate hybrid search into RAG hook
